name: Corrupt Manifestation's Bracers
summary: Tainted bracers lie on the coast of Silverpine Forest, remnants of a corrupted water elemental. Shaman initiates recover them during the Call of Water and cast them into the Brazier of Everfount with pure water to cleanse the shrine and summon a pure water spirit.

sections.title: A Cleansing Offering
sections.body: The Scourge's plague reached the spirits of Lordaeron. Along Silverpine Forest's misty coast, west of the Sepulcher, a sacred water shrine fell to corruption. Its water manifestation became an aggressive shade. Shaman initiates must defeat it and recover its bracers. At the Brazier of Everfount, they cast the bindings into the flame with pure water, lifting the corruption and calling forth an unblemished water spirit.

faq.q: What are these bracers used for?
faq.answer: The bracers are cast into the Brazier of Everfount with pure water during a cleansing rite. The rite purges corruption from the Silverpine shrine and calls forth a pure water spirit.

faq.q: Where do the bracers come from?
faq.answer: The bracers come from a Corrupt Minor Manifestation of Water near a tainted elemental shrine on the Silverpine Forest coast, west of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Why did the water elemental become corrupt?
faq.answer: The plague and dark powers that blighted Lordaeron warped the elemental and severed the local spirits from communion with shamans.

angles.text: As a shaman, recovering and purifying these bracers is the final trial of the Call of Water. It proves your power to soothe and restore distorted elements.
